title: Lindsay Clancy’s irate lawyer rocks back and forth as he fights for holdout juror to be removed
text:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

Lindsay Clancy’s lawyer was raging in the moments before he demanded that a holdout juror be booted from the murder case Thursday.

Kevin Reddington was scowling with a hand placed angrily on his hip before Judge William Sullivan called a sidebar lawyers from both sides.

Clancy, meanwhile, looked as downcast and as despondent as she has since jurors began deliberating.

When the fuming lawyer returned from the sidebar, he appeared to whack a microphone  into place at the podium — before slamming his papers down, raising his voice, and gesticulating as he spoke to the  judge.

“There’s one juror who refuses to listen to the law that you’ve given him or her on reasonable doubt. And I suggest respectfully that the soft instruction that you gave them at the sidebar saying ‘can you listen to the law as I instruct you does not focus on the issue,” Reddington raged.

“The question was not sufficient enough. If we come back here in a half an hour with a mistrial because of a juror that has just spurned the instructions of the court it’s a shame.”

He then demanded that person be kicked off the 12-person jury, of nine women and three men, that has been deliberating for roughly 36 hours spread over six days.

Reddington has asked jurors to find Clancy not guilty by reason of insanity based on the claim she was in the throes of severe postpartum psychosis and hallucinated a voice telling her to carry out the slayings and take her own life.
